children.description: Sculpture and color. Hinge. Adductor muscle and pallial scars. Moderate in size, moderately impressed, anterior scar subovate, posterior scar ovate-elongate; pallial line narrow, with long, narrow dorsally directed lines extending from it. Inner ventral crenulations. About 24 (14 – 43) rectangular, flat topped.
